CREATE TABLE polaris.p3_iceberg.nested USING iceberg AS SELECT id,
              named_struct('name','name','w',CAST(1 AS INT),'obsolete',1) AS s,
              map('key', named_struct('decimal_value', CAST(1.25 AS DECIMAL(6,2)))) AS m,
              array(named_struct('amount', CAST(0.5 AS FLOAT), 'other', 2)) AS a FROM range(4)
ALTER TABLE polaris.p3_iceberg.nested RENAME COLUMN s.name TO label
ALTER TABLE polaris.p3_iceberg.nested ADD COLUMN s.added STRING
ALTER TABLE polaris.p3_iceberg.nested DROP COLUMN s.obsolete
ALTER TABLE polaris.p3_iceberg.nested ALTER COLUMN s.w FIRST
ALTER TABLE polaris.p3_iceberg.nested ALTER COLUMN s.w TYPE BIGINT
ALTER TABLE polaris.p3_iceberg.nested ALTER COLUMN a.element.amount TYPE DOUBLE
ALTER TABLE polaris.p3_iceberg.nested ALTER COLUMN m.value.decimal_value TYPE DECIMAL(12,2)
